The reason is also in the code comment, the S1 pin and the changeset.
- The shipped shape's restart-dependent answer is carried by #34441 (record 6922561329 ③). The out-of-scope disabled-holder plus package-less row shape (records 6915442261 and 6922561329) is carried by #34440.
